meta.title: Hip & Knee Replacement Recovery | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Restoring movement and strength for a safe return to daily life.

overview: Hip and knee replacements are among the most commonly performed orthopaedic procedures, yet post-operative rehabilitation is a critical factor in determining how fully a patient recovers.

At Cambridge Hospital, our joint-replacement programme guides patients from first mobilisation through gait retraining, strengthening, stair practice and return to daily activities. Outpatient sessions and home care physiotherapy continue progress after discharge, minimising recovery time and maximising long-term function.
